object.script:
function onTick() course_lock = input.getBool(1) target_x = input.getNumber(1) target_y = input.getNumber(2) target_course = input.getNumber(3) / 360 depth = input.getNumber(4) course = input.getNumber(5) x = input.getNumber(6) y = input.getNumber(7)
delta_x = target_x - x delta_y = target_y - y
if not course_lock then target_course = 0.25 - math.atan(delta_y / delta_x) / (2 * math.pi)
if delta_x < 0 then target_course = target_course + 0.5 end end
if target_course < 0.5 then target_course = -target_course else target_course = 1 - target_course end
turn = course - target_course if turn > 0.5 then turn = 1 - turn else if turn < -0.5 then turn = 1 + turn end end
distance = (delta_x ^ 2 + delta_y ^ 2) ^ 0.5
output.setNumber(1, math.max(-1, math.min(1, turn * 10))) output.setNumber(2, depth) output.setNumber(3, distance) end
